_comment: ADLC pipeline allowlist — copied into each project's .claude/settings.json by /init. Reduces permission prompts during /proceed by pre-approving the routine read/write/git/gh/test/agent operations the pipeline fires. Destructive or production-impact operations remain on the ask list.

hooks.command:
ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"; [ -n "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT" ] || [ ! -d "$HOME/.claude/skills/partials" ] || ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="$HOME/.claude/skills"; [ -n "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT" ] || ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT=$(cat "$HOME/.claude/adlc/plugin-root" 2>/dev/null); export ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="${ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/skills}"
[ -f .adlc/partials/ethos-inject.sh ] || [ -f "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT/partials/ethos-inject.sh" ] || exit 0
if [ -f .adlc/partials/ethos-inject.sh ]; then . .adlc/partials/ethos-inject.sh; else . "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT/partials/ethos-inject.sh"; fi
adlc_ethos_inject

ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"; [ -n "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT" ] || [ ! -d "$HOME/.claude/skills/partials" ] || ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="$HOME/.claude/skills"; [ -n "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT" ] || ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT=$(cat "$HOME/.claude/adlc/plugin-root" 2>/dev/null); export ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="${ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/skills}"
[ -f .adlc/partials/session-record.sh ] || [ -f "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT/partials/session-record.sh" ] || exit 0
if [ -f .adlc/partials/session-record.sh ]; then . .adlc/partials/session-record.sh; else . "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT/partials/session-record.sh"; fi
adlc_session_record

ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"; [ -n "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT" ] || [ ! -d "$HOME/.claude/skills/partials" ] || ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="$HOME/.claude/skills"; [ -n "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT" ] || ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT=$(cat "$HOME/.claude/adlc/plugin-root" 2>/dev/null); export ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="${ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/skills}"

if [ -f .adlc/partials/ethos-inject.sh ]; then . .adlc/partials/ethos-inject.sh; else . "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT/partials/ethos-inject.sh"; fi
